AboutMe.text: From a young age, I was fascinated by building computers and understanding how they worked inside. That curiosity led me to programming, where the idea of creating things from scratch, solving problems, and watching something I wrote come to life completely captivated me. Today, as a Full Stack developer with a background in software engineering, I carry that same passion into building digital solutions that work beautifully and feel intuitive to use. With more than two years of experience developing modern web applications, I keep learning and growing to make every project better than the last.
AboutMe.pros: Programming turns dreams into code that can change the world.

swiftStake.name: Swift Stake
swiftStake.description: Swift Stake is a fast, secure staking platform that enables users to participate in decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. The project integrates real-time APIs to provide current opportunities and rewards. With a focus on user experience and security, it simplifies earning passive income through blockchain technology.

landingTurtle.name: Landing Turtle
landingTurtle.description: Landing Turtle is an animated, visually engaging landing page built to showcase modern web design techniques. Using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, it demonstrates smooth animations, responsive layouts, and creative interface elements. It works as a template for startups and personal portfolios seeking a memorable first impression.

chatbotAI.name: Chatbot AI
chatbotAI.description: Chatbot AI is an intelligent conversational assistant powered by the DeepSeek API and Next.js. It can answer questions, provide recommendations, and automate tasks. Its focus on natural-language understanding and a friendly interface brings the power of artificial intelligence to everyday interactions.
